tools.name: get_component_api
tools.description:
Get the full API documentation for a specific Vega component, including props, methods, and events.

CRITICAL - Refresh gate:
If refresh_knowledge_base already succeeded in this conversation, call this read tool directly. Re-read package.json and refresh again only when the user explicitly says Vega version or package scope changed (for example, "switched to 2.72.0", "upgraded vega", "switched to @heartlandone", "switched to @globalpayments", or "changed the package").

Only when refresh is required:
1. Read the user project package.json and merge dependencies and devDependencies.
2. Detect the installed Vega package from either org scope in this priority order (first match wins):
   - "@globalpayments/vega-react" or "@heartlandone/vega-react"   -> framework: "react"
   - "@globalpayments/vega-vue" or "@heartlandone/vega-vue"       -> framework: "vue"
   - "@globalpayments/vega-angular" or "@heartlandone/vega-angular" -> framework: "angular"
   - "@globalpayments/vega" or "@heartlandone/vega"               -> framework: "html"
   Note: the base package (@globalpayments/vega or @heartlandone/vega) may coexist with a framework package; prefer the framework package.
3. Use the version from the matched package as vegaVersion. Strip any leading ^, ~, or v (for example ^2.86.1 -> 2.86.1). Use "latest" only when no Vega package exists.
4. Set packageScope from the matched package name: @heartlandone/vega* -> "heartlandone"; @globalpayments/vega* -> "globalpayments".
5. Call refresh_knowledge_base once with the detected version and packageScope.
6. For this read tool, reuse the vegaVersion/framework already loaded by refresh_knowledge_base. Do NOT run detection again.

tools.name: refresh_knowledge_base
tools.description:
Load or switch the Vega knowledge base to a specific version. This call awaits the download/load to complete before returning.

CRITICAL: In once mode, call this tool only before the first Vega tool call in the conversation.
After the first successful refresh, do NOT call refresh_knowledge_base again and do NOT proactively re-read package.json.
Call refresh_knowledge_base again only if the user explicitly says the Vega version changed (e.g. "switched to 2.72.0", "upgraded vega") OR the package scope changed (e.g. "switched to @heartlandone", "switched to @globalpayments", "changed the package").
Package scope changes only the packageScope argument; it never disables refresh by itself.

When calling:
1. Read the user project package.json and merge dependencies and devDependencies.
2. Detect the installed Vega package from either org scope in this priority order (first match wins):
   - "@globalpayments/vega-react" or "@heartlandone/vega-react"   -> framework: "react"
   - "@globalpayments/vega-vue" or "@heartlandone/vega-vue"       -> framework: "vue"
   - "@globalpayments/vega-angular" or "@heartlandone/vega-angular" -> framework: "angular"
   - "@globalpayments/vega" or "@heartlandone/vega"               -> framework: "html"
   Note: the base package (@globalpayments/vega or @heartlandone/vega) may coexist with a framework package; prefer the framework package.
3. Use the version from the matched package as vegaVersion. Strip any leading ^, ~, or v (for example ^2.86.1 -> 2.86.1). Use "latest" only when no Vega package exists.
4. Set packageScope from the matched package name: @heartlandone/vega* -> "heartlandone"; @globalpayments/vega* -> "globalpayments".
5. Call this tool with the detected version and packageScope.

vegaVersion.description: Vega docs version to load (for example "2.73.0", "2.73.0-beta.1", or "latest"). Read this from the user project package.json Vega package version and remove any leading ^, ~, or v.

refreshCache.description: When true, bypass and overwrite the local cache for this version. Defaults to false.

packageScope.description: Required org scope from the detected Vega package in package.json. Use "heartlandone" only for @heartlandone/vega* packages. Use "globalpayments" for @globalpayments/vega* packages.
